title: Thanksgiving service and first Friday prayer in the Palace of the Chosroes
description: After taking Al-Medain, Sa'd turned the royal palace into a house of prayer and held a service of praise, reading from the Kor'an the passage on Pharaoh and Sura xliv. 24 f. The grand hall was consecrated as a place of prayer, and there the Friday service of Islam was first celebrated in the land of Persia (A.H. 15-16). Dated to the year 0637 by the source.

sources.citation: Sir William Muir, The Caliphate: Its Rise, Decline, and Fall, "A.H. 15-16."
